highlights:
# Verda Appoints Mikko Einiö as Chief Financial Officer to Lead Capital Strategy 

 Aug 6, 2026 | Verda content team | 3 min read 

 Former Morgan Stanley banker and Nokia Head of Corporate Development joins Verda as the company scales its global AI infrastructure platform 

 HELSINKI, FINLAND. 6th August 2026. Verda, the European AI cloud provider, today announced the appointment of Mikko Einiö as Chief Financial Officer. Einiö will lead Verda's finance organization, including financial planning, capital raising and capital allocation, as the company expands its AI infrastructure platform globally. 

 The appointment follows a period of rapid growth for Verda. The company reached an annualised revenue run rate of approximately $120 million in June 2026, representing tenfold growth over the preceding 18 months. Verda is expanding its infrastructure and operations across Europe, the United States and Asia in response to growing global demand for high-performance AI compute.

...

## On-Demand, High-Performance Compute 

 Verda's core product is on-demand access to high-performance compute for AI workloads. Customers can provision compute instantly, scale it according to workload requirements, and stop when it is no longer needed, all without going through a sales process or committing to a long-term contract. 

 Verda manages the full stack from physical data centres and server hardware through to the cloud platform that gives AI teams access to high compute performance in terms of speed, reliability and cost. Verda is one of a select group of NVIDIA Preferred Partners globally.
